ai.scribeBody: Dictate the visit and get an AI draft to review. Nothing is saved until you approve it.
ai.dictationIntro: Record or type the visit. The AI turns it into a draft note that you must review.
ai.voiceHint: You can also type, or use the microphone key on your keyboard.

ai.working: Drafting… this can take up to a minute.
ai.disabledHint: An administrator can turn on AI assistance in the console settings.

ai.warn.range: {{field}} was out of range and removed: {{value}}

ai.rejectBody: Nothing from it will be saved.
ai.statusBody.approved: This draft was approved and applied.

ai.recordTooShort: The recording was too short. Try again.
ai.recordLimit: Recording stopped at the time limit.

insurance.title: Insurance
insurance.intro: Insurance on file with the clinic. You can add your insurance card here; the clinic verifies it before it is used on your bills.
insurance.addIntro: Enter the details exactly as they appear on the card. Reception will verify them with the insurer, usually at your next visit.
insurance.memberNumberHint: As printed on the card, 2 to 60 characters.
insurance.submitted: Insurance card submitted. The clinic will verify it before it is used on your bills.
insurance.noPayers: Online submission is not available for any insurer at the moment. Please bring your card to reception.
insurance.pendingNote: Not used on bills until the clinic verifies the card.
insurance.pendingExplain: Cards you add here are checked by the clinic's reception with the insurer. Until a card is verified it is not applied to your bills, so you may be asked to pay the full amount and claim later. Bring the card to your next visit to speed this up.
insurance.closedNote: This submission was withdrawn or was not accepted by the clinic. Contact reception if you think this is a mistake.
insurance.withdrawConfirm: The clinic will no longer verify this card.
insurance.withdrawTooLate: This card has already been verified by the clinic and can no longer be withdrawn. Contact reception to change it.
insurance.error.tooManyPending: This person already has {{max}} cards awaiting verification. Withdraw one or wait for the clinic to verify them.
insurance.error.invalidDates: The end date must be on or after the start date.
insurance.error.planUnavailable: This insurance plan is no longer available. Please choose another plan.
insurance.error.patientNotOnAccount: This person is not on your account. Choose a family member from the list.
insurance.error.memberNumber: Enter the member number from the card (2 to 60 characters).
insurance.validToHint: Valid until: leave empty if no end date
complaint.historyEmpty: You have not sent any complaints.
insurance.statusWithdrawnNote: You withdrew this card before the clinic checked it. Add it again if you still want to use it.
insurance.statusRejectedNote: The clinic could not verify this card with the insurer. Contact reception for details, or add the card again with the correct details.
